context.transcript:
Thanks for meeting with us, Mr. Samir.
Maria and I are pleased that your city is planning to start using our company's new fare payment system in your train stations.
Yes.
My transportation department is eager to introduce the new tap-to-pay technology your company created.
Great.
We advise starting off by installing our payment devices in a limited number of stations.
Maybe target the less busy stations first.
That makes sense.
Could you provide the latest ridership statistics so we'll know the number of passengers that use each station?
Sure.
But I'm concerned about the project deadline.
Can we be sure all stations have it by the end of the year?
context.transcript_translation:
感谢您和我们见面，萨米尔先生。
玛丽亚和我很高兴您的城市计划在火车站使用我们公司的新的票务支付系统。
是的。
我的交通部门渴望引入贵公司创造的新的非接触式支付技术。
太好了。
我们建议先从在有限数量的车站安装我们的支付设备开始。
也许可以先瞄准人流量较少的车站。
有道理。
您能提供最新的客运量统计数据吗，这样我们就能知道每个车站使用多少乘客？
当然可以。
但我担心项目的截止日期。
我们能确保到年底所有车站都安装好吗？
